sources.title: autotrust/JEV-27B-VL: a decision model that learned to see without a ...
sources.snippet: Today we are releasing autotrust/JEV-27B-VL, JEV-27B with vision. Show it images and text, ask a question, and it answers in one forward pass with a calibrated probability for every option. When a question needs more thought, the same model thinks it through step by step, and it can look at the images while it does.
